gal-1-3.anchor: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

gal-1-24.anchor: And they glorified God in me.

gal-2-3.anchor: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

gal-2-18.anchor: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

gal-3-9.anchor: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

gal-3-26.anchor: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

gal-4-10.anchor: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

gal-4-28.anchor: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

gal-5-9.anchor: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

gal-5-15.anchor: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

gal-6-5.anchor: For every man shall bear his own burden.

gal-6-6.anchor: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
